stories.title: Is Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith the best WR college football has ever seen?
stories.summary: Larry Fitzgerald, Jaxon Smith-Njigba are among those endorsing the Buckeyes star.

stories.title: Ranking CFB's best receivers of the last 50 years
stories.summary: As Jeremiah Smith continues to amaze, Bill Connelly looks at where his career fits among the best ever.

stories.title: Falcons say QB Penix on track to start vs. Bears if no setbacks
stories.summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will start Sunday against the Bears despite a rib injury, as long as there are no setbacks during the week.

stories.title: Espada not returning as Astros manager after winning AL West
stories.summary: Joe Espada, who guided the Houston Astros to two American League West titles in his three seasons as manager, will not be returning to the team in 2027.

stories.title: Mattingly stays on as Phillies manager, reaching 2-year deal
stories.summary: Don Mattingly, who guided the Phillies to the playoffs after taking over as interim manager just 28 games into the season, reached a two-year deal to return.
